product.description: A Revolut credit card with interest-free periods on purchases and variable interest rates. Features and fees vary depending on your plan. See our website for details.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Available to eligible customers only. Business customers should apply for a Revolut Business account.
Select visa types are also eligible.
eligibility.additionalValue: Must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident.

features.additionalInfo: Up to 5 secondary credit card holders.
Virtual card available instantly in-app. Physical card delivery and other card fees may also apply depending on your plan - see our website for more info.
features.additionalValue: Visa or Mastercard credit card (physical and virtual)

features.additionalInfo: Manage your everyday spending with powerful budgeting and analytics, transfer money abroad, spend easily in the local currency, and so much more.
Available for both physical and virtual Revolut cards.
Real-time transaction monitoring, instant card freeze via app and disposable virtual card numbers.
If you are subscribed to a Paid Plan, you may be eligible for complimentary insurance cover.
Up to 44 days interest-free on purchases when the full balance is paid by the due date.
Earn RevPoints on eligible card purchases. Redeemable with multiple airlines and other options. T&Cs apply.

features.additionalValue: Instant push notifications for card payments

features.additionalInfo: Pay and receive near real-time payments.
Mobile number and email address PayID supported; register via the Revolut app under Account Settings.
